title: La Villette
summary: PRO and DCE construction drawings for the rehabilitation of a block of three buildings in Paris 19th, including an ABF-listed building.

quote.text: Here, drawings don’t communicate | they contractualize.

role.text: Development of the DCE detail booklet: interior and exterior joinery, systematic indexing of secondary works elements.

Residential and commercial rehabilitation of a block of three distinct buildings | Paris 19th, ABF-listed building. Combined constraints: absolute NGF levels, ERP classification, PLU zoning, ABF prescriptions, PPRI constraints.
